title: SoFi  | Interview with its Co-Founder & VP of Community - Dan Macklin
description:
Read the complete interview transcript of the interview with the co-founder of SoFi here: http://www.cleverism.com/sofi-interview-with-its-co-founder-vp-of-community-dan-macklin/

In San Francisco (CA), we meet Co-Founder & VP of Community of SoFi, Dan Macklin. Dan talks about his story how he came up with the idea and founded SoFi, how the current business model works, as well as he provides some advice for young entrepreneurs.
